description: This file is a JavaScript module that acts as a root alias for the plugin SDK in a larger project. It provides functions for loading SDK components, resolving paths, managing module aliases, and proxying exports from possibly monolithic or distributed SDK implementations.

methods.name: emptyPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Returns a schema object for plugin configuration validation, ensuring the config object is empty or undefined.

methods.name: resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers
methods.description: Determines if a command is authorized based on provided authorizer configurations and mode.

methods.name: resolveControlCommandGate
methods.description: Resolves whether a control command should be blocked or allowed based on authorization.

methods.name: onDiagnosticEvent
methods.description: Registers a listener for diagnostic events from the diagnostic events module.

methods.name: getPackageRoot
methods.description: Returns the root directory of the package.

methods.name: findDistChunkByPrefix
methods.description: Finds a distribution chunk file in the dist directory with a given prefix.

methods.name: listPluginSdkExportedSubpaths
methods.description: Lists the subpaths exported by the plugin SDK as defined in package.json.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkAliasMap
methods.description: Builds a map of module aliases for the plugin SDK, depending on whether dist build or source is used.

methods.name: getJiti
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JITI (Just-In-Time) loader for runtime module transpilation.

methods.name: loadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Loads the SDK as a monolithic bundle if available.

methods.name: loadDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Loads the diagnostic events module, preferring dist build if applicable.

methods.name: normalizeDiagnosticEventsModule
methods.description: Normalizes the diagnostic events module to ensure it has the expected interfaces.

methods.name: tryLoadMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Attempts to load the monolithic SDK, returns null if it fails.

methods.name: getMonolithicSdk
methods.description: Returns the loaded monolithic SDK if available.

methods.name: getExportValue
methods.description: Retrieves a property from the monolithic SDK if not present in the local target.

methods.name: getExportDescriptor
methods.description: Retrieves and possibly modifies the property descriptor for a given symbol, considering monolithic SDK fallback.
